Class TextInputState

Namespace
Tuinet.Widgets
Assembly
Tuinet.dll

Editable single-line text: emacs-style editing keys, Shift+movement selection, undo/redo and optional masking, on the shared Tuinet.Widgets.EditableText core. The caret moves and deletes by grapheme cluster (an emoji sequence or a letter with its accents is one step). Line breaks and other control characters are dropped. Owned by the app.

public sealed class TextInputState : EditableText

Methods

Handle(KeyEvent)

Apply an editing key. Returns false if the key is not an editing key (e.g. Tab, Enter, Up). On top of the shared keys (see Tuinet.Widgets.EditableText): Home/End (Shift selects), Ctrl+A/E/B/F, Ctrl+U/K/W/D and Alt+B/F/D.

public bool Handle(KeyEvent key)

Parameters

key KeyEvent

Returns

bool

HandleMouse(MouseEvent)

A click on the input moves the caret to the clicked cluster (or the end, past the text), as the last render showed it, so clicking an unfocused input works too. Shift+click selects to there, and dragging selects. Returns whether the event was used.

public bool HandleMouse(MouseEvent ev)
